result.document_summary: Boston Department of Neighborhood Development's Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (February 2017) limiting criminal-history and credit-score use in tenant selection by housing providers receiving DND funding/land or operating BPDA inclusionary units.
result.notes: The policy applies only to housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy; it is a city agency policy, not a citywide ordinance. No effective date is stated beyond the February 2017 document date, so effective_date is left blank. The credit-score restriction is folded into this single screening_restrictions instrument. Federal or state criminal history requirements preempt the policy.

rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (criminal history and credit screening limits)
rules.requirement: Covered housing providers may not impose blanket denials based on arrests or convictions and must not consider non-conviction arrests, judicially relieved convictions, juvenile records, or convictions more than 5 years old (subject to exceptions for direct relationship/unreasonable risk of harm). They also may not use applicants' credit scores to approve or deny applications.
rules.key_value: No blanket bans; no consideration of arrests without conviction, sealed/expunged or juvenile records, or convictions over 5 years old; no credit score use
rules.citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (DND, Feb. 2017)
rules.quoted_span:
will not impose a blanket policy that denies 
housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on 
a case-by-case basis.
rules.coverage_text: Housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy (also applied to the Office of Fair Housing and Equity Affirmative Marketing Program).

all_of.value: receives DND funding/land or has BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units
all_of.text: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy

rules.exemptions_text: Criminal-history limits do not apply where there is a direct relationship between a conviction and the housing sought and/or unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, or to current criminal behavior.
rules.interaction: Where federal or state law imposes a criminal history requirement that conflicts with this guidance, the federal or state law preempts the policy.
